d:
A soulful fusion of traditional melodies and contemporary beats. Immerse yourself in its oh-so-amazing lyrics and the voice of Alka Yagnik alongside Richa Sharma, Pooja Tiwari, and Yashika Sikka. Get ready to lose yourself in the magic of this captivating composition.
Credits:
Singers - Alka Yagnik, Richa Sharma, Pooja Tiwari, Yashika Sikka
Song Composed, Produced, Arranged by A.R. Rahman
Lyrics by Irshad Kamil
Music Supervisor - Hiral Viradia
Mixed and Mastered by Nitish R Kumar
